title: Add a dark-surface focus ring token alongside the ink ring
context: Wave 3 pre-launch audit: the base control's ring is a 3 dp ink token, but the video recorder's close, shutter and camera picker sit on a dark camera surface where an ink ring is nearly invisible. The app's dark toolbars already hand-draw a 2 dp label-coloured ring.
options: Second token matching the dark-toolbar ring; base control takes a light or dark choice
outcome: Owner chose: a second token for dark surfaces, matching the existing dark-toolbar ring (2 dp, label colour). The base control takes a light or dark choice; controls on the video recorder and camera picker use dark.
